name: The Broken Construct

angles.text: As an engineer, you know the frustration of troubleshooting a construct with complicated mechanical parts.

faq.answer: Riaani Nightwind is a tinkerer working on a disabled mechanical construct. He doubts newcomers sent to help, but needs assistance to get the machine working again.
Ayessa is an associate who sends travelers to help Riaani Nightwind with his mechanical troubles. Her referral persuades him to consider putting a newcomer to work.
The broken construct is a mechanical creation that has stopped working properly. Riaani Nightwind is inside it, searching for the parts and tasks needed for repairs.

aliases: what does riaani want me to do
faq.answer: Ayessa has sent you to help Riaani. He needs time to climb out of the construct's inner workings and explain what help he needs.
faq.q: What does Riaani need help with?

aliases: why does riaani call me a novice
faq.answer: Riaani is absorbed in technical work and impatient when interrupted. He sees most adventurers as untrained novices until they show they can follow mechanical instructions.
faq.q: Why is Riaani skeptical of your help?

sections.body: Ayessa sends you to help Riaani Nightwind with a damaged construct. He is deep among its inner parts, searching for the cause of the trouble. Surprised by your arrival, Riaani doubts an untrained traveler can manage delicate mechanical work. Once he climbs out, he agrees to explain what needs doing.
sections.title: Assisting the Artisan

sections.body: A construct depends on precise assembly and careful calibration. When it breaks down, its engineer faces serious work. Riaani Nightwind is shoulder-deep in mechanical parts and needs another pair of hands to gather materials or test the machine in the field. Listen to his briefing to learn how you can help bring the inert construct back to working order.
sections.title: Troubleshooting Machinery

summary: Ayessa has sent you to help Riaani Nightwind with a disabled construct. Hear his plans and learn what he needs done to set the machine right.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Broken Construct
